voice.customToneDescription: We sound like a helpful senior student: friendly, factual, never hype-y. No ALL CAPS, max one emoji per post.
voice.examplePositive: Applications for the AI/DS fellowship are open until 30 November. Here's what the programme covers.
voice.exampleNegative: 🔥🔥 BEST PROGRAM EVER!!! Don't miss out, guaranteed placement!!!

platformRules.linkedin: Professional and insight-led. No slang, no more than 3 hashtags.
platformRules.instagram: Conversational, short caption, up to 5 hashtags at the end.
platformRules.reddit: Never promotional. Lead with useful information; disclose affiliation.
platformRules.whatsapp: Personal and short. No hashtags; one clear call to action.
platformRules.telegram: Clear announcement style. Short paragraphs, links at the end.
platformRules.discord: Friendly community tone. Keep it short; no mass pings.
platformRules.medium: Long-form and informative. Use headings; cite facts.
platformRules.quora: Answer the question first, then mention the brand only if relevant and disclose affiliation.
platformRules.pinterest: Descriptive and keyword-rich, one sentence plus a call to action.
platformRules.tumblr: Casual and creative; tags at the end.
platformRules.generic: Follow the general brand voice: clear, plain-spoken, verified facts only.

terminology.explanation: Always spell the product name correctly.
We cannot promise jobs; legal requires 'placement support'.

facts.fact: Plumbline checks posts against brand guidelines before they are published
Over 40 student clubs piloted Plumbline in 2026

rulebookText: Claims policy. Any number, percentage, ranking or award in a public post must match an approved fact in Brand Knowledge, including its source. Pending or outdated facts must not be published. Words such as best, number one, leading, first or guaranteed are treated as claims and need an approved fact. Partnerships may only be named after the partner has signed off in writing. Community policy. Reply to questions within 24 hours, never argue in public, and move account-specific issues to direct messages. Never share personal data of students in posts or replies.
